name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
summary: Free GitHub Pro, Copilot for students and a bundle of free developer tools while you study.
key: Free GitHub Pro while you are a student, plus GitHub Copilot Student.
who: Aged 13 or over and enrolled in a degree- or diploma-granting program.
You need your own personal GitHub account.
numbers: Free while you are a student
Unlimited code completions, an allowance of AI credits, and limited chat and agent use
Codespaces, Azure, JetBrains and more. Each has its own length and terms.
how: Sign in to GitHub and open Settings, then Education benefits, and apply as a student.
catches: Partner offers run for different lengths. Some last a year, some need renewing.
need: A verified academic email on your GitHub account, if your school issues one.
Proof of current enrolment, such as a dated student ID, class schedule or enrolment letter.
